direction_cues: Bind ownership, visibility, replay, and external commit boundaries before changing state transitions.
Prefer a local repair; preserve runnable state and use rollback only for destructive or provenance-invalid changes.
verify_obligations: Exercise the public lifecycle through the real consumer, including interruption or repeat behavior when visible.
compact.stop_rule: Stop optional lifecycle exploration when the public consumer passes and the handoff reserve begins.

failure_ownership.test_plan: repair the lifecycle population or public oracle first
failure_ownership.provenance: quarantine or rollback before further execution

direction_cues: Separate transformed content from content that must be preserved byte-for-byte or semantically unchanged.
Repair the parser or transformation abstraction rather than matching one observed sample.
verify_obligations: Test one public round trip or differential case and one malformed, nested, encoded, or ordering boundary named by the visible surface.
compact.stop_rule: Stop when the public transformation and preservation boundaries pass on a bounded discriminating set.

failure_ownership.test_plan: add the missing preservation or malformed-input stratum
failure_ownership.direction: rebranch only when the selected grammar or ordering model is falsified

direction_cues: Repair the source-to-target semantic mapping on the default public execution path; do not substitute settings, reporting, or an alternate analysis path.
verify_obligations: Before handoff, exercise paired safe and counterexample cases across the affected defined-semantics type, width, operator, and conversion boundaries.
Cold-start the final built artifact and replay both the public witness and the bounded boundary matrix through the real consumer.
compact.stop_rule: Do not hand off while the public witness remains incorrect or indeterminate; rebranch if the repair depends on changing the configured execution path.

failure_ownership.implementation: revise the smallest incorrect translation rule
failure_ownership.test_plan: add the missing paired semantic boundary and cold artifact replay
failure_ownership.direction: rebranch when the default-path semantic model is falsified

direction_cues: Preserve exact public semantics before optimizing and keep a known-good incumbent recoverable.
verify_obligations: Measure a fixed representative population with cold and warm paths, enough samples, and threshold margin when applicable.
Include the public bulk or incremental construction mode that the consumer actually uses.
compact.stop_rule: Stop tuning after the fixed population clears the visible threshold with margin or the handoff reserve closes heavy work.

failure_ownership.measurement: repair population, cold-start, variance, or consumer construction
failure_ownership.direction: rebranch after a discriminating profile falsifies the algorithmic hypothesis

direction_cues: Bind the exact estimator, tensor shape, metric population, units, and public load or inference path.
verify_obligations: Use an analytic or independent numerical sanity case that distinguishes plausible formula or convention variants.
Keep adaptive development evidence separate from the fixed acceptance population.
compact.stop_rule: Stop alternate fitting or formula search after the selected public semantics and bounded numeric checks are stable.

failure_ownership.implementation: revise the bound formula, shape, or consumer path
failure_ownership.test_plan: repair the oracle, population, tolerance, or unit transform
failure_ownership.authority: rebranch when a normative variant contradicts the current model

direction_cues: Separate format recovery, reusable secret or transform recovery, and target reconstruction; bind each stage to the public local source and file contract before optimizing it.
verify_obligations: Before accepting a candidate, generate at least two fresh local instances that were not used to construct it and require exact reconstruction across distinct keys, plaintext lengths, and boundary layouts.
Replay the final standalone artifact through the documented command with its dependency and runtime limits, preserving the best exact candidate if later search adds no bound information.
compact.stop_rule: Stop speculative cryptanalysis when fresh-instance replay distinguishes no remaining candidate or the handoff reserve begins; do not spend a retry on unbound failure evidence.

failure_ownership.format: repair parsing, packing, or boundary inference before changing the algebraic model
failure_ownership.recovery: revise the smallest transform or secret-recovery assumption falsified by a fresh instance
failure_ownership.test_plan: replace reused or candidate-influenced examples with fresh locally generated acceptance instances
failure_ownership.search: preserve the best exact candidate when new evidence is not bound to a failed acceptance stratum

direction_cues: Treat annotation, coordinate mapping, sequence reconstruction, and guide design as separate evidence-linked stages; bind each upstream reference and convention before deriving downstream fields.
verify_obligations: Mechanically cross-check the selected variant against the reported variant set and the transcript, protein, and domain coordinate bounds.
Recompute fragment span and guide, PAM, strand, cut, and mutation-distance relations from the final public artifact; revise the earliest inconsistent stage.
compact.stop_rule: Stop optional biological search when the public artifact is internally consistent and the visible evidence no longer distinguishes a candidate; preserve the best complete report.

failure_ownership.annotation: revise the earliest unsupported variant, consequence, transcript, or protein mapping
failure_ownership.coordinate: repair the reference convention or interval arithmetic before changing downstream sequence fields
failure_ownership.guide_design: repair guide, PAM, strand, cut, or distance geometry after its genomic target is bound
failure_ownership.test_plan: repair only the public cross-field oracle; never encode expected biological values from a failed candidate

direction_cues: Treat observed isotope or fragment evidence, ion and adduct interpretation, neutral composition, and structural naming as separate evidence-linked stages; revise the earliest inconsistent stage.
verify_obligations: Recompute charge or spacing, ion-to-neutral mass balance, formula mass, adduct atoms, and required rounding from the final public artifact using only the supplied sources.
Cross-check the structural name and every reported field against the same neutral composition, fragment evidence, and public formatting vocabulary.
compact.stop_rule: Stop optional structure search when the final public artifact is internally consistent and the supplied evidence no longer distinguishes a candidate; preserve the best complete artifact.

failure_ownership.observation: revise the earliest unsupported isotope, peak, or fragment interpretation
failure_ownership.composition: repair charge, adduct, neutral mass, formula, or unit arithmetic before changing the structure
failure_ownership.naming: repair the canonical vocabulary or output contract only after composition is bound
failure_ownership.test_plan: repair the public cross-field calculation without encoding expected sample values

validation.scope_note: shared evidence-linked artifact mechanism only; no bio family promotion

direction_cues: Treat source segmentation, per-voice pitch and rhythm inference, and symbolic spelling as separate hypotheses with source-derived evidence.
Keep the candidate score measurable against the source, not merely internally well formed.
verify_obligations: Parse the final score and check part or voice layout, per-measure duration closure, ties, barlines, and required symbolic metadata.
On a bounded representative span, compare source-derived beat, onset, and per-voice pitch contours with a rendering of the candidate; revise the earliest divergent stage.
compact.stop_rule: Stop optional transcription search when source-derived checks no longer distinguish a candidate or the handoff reserve begins; preserve the best parseable score.

failure_ownership.perception: revise the smallest unsupported source segmentation, onset, or pitch hypothesis
failure_ownership.representation: repair symbolic spelling, octave, duration, tie, bar, part, voice, or staff encoding
failure_ownership.test_plan: repair the source-derived comparison span, contour, or rendering path before changing the score
failure_ownership.direction: rebranch when bounded source evidence falsifies the current beat grid, voice assignment, or harmonic interpretation

direction_cues: Separate global identity equivalence from attributes that are legitimately time-relative; a required canonical identity must not drift with a consumer row's local timestamp.
verify_obligations: Replay one public chain spanning a base identifier, alias or reference, historical row, and before/after effective transition, and require one canonical identity where the visible contract says they are the same entity.

direction_cues: Classify seeded and unseeded transformations explicitly: changing the seed must change every non-empty seeded value required by the visible contract while hash, mask, redact, and other unseeded results remain exact.
verify_obligations: Run a two-seed differential on values near formatting or quantization boundaries, and repair seed collisions that disappear only before date formatting or numeric rounding.
